scheme_name: West Bengal Handloom and Khadi Weavers Financial Benefit Scheme 2024: Assistance to Individual Handloom Weaver
other_conditions: Applicant must be an individual weaver.
Individual weavers must not be under the ambit of any Primary Weavers’ Cooperative Societies.
benefits_summary: Provides ₹5,000 for work‑shed/loom repairs and ₹10,000 for raw‑material (yarn) assistance procured through Tantuja.
